title: Seagrove 281 Elm Street Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewPet Friendly Seagrove Beach Bungalow with Private Pool & Golf Cart!The SpaceSeagrove Sandcastle | Escape to Coastal BlissQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Pet-Friendly – Bring your furry friend (with fee)! New 2022 Saltwater Pool & Spa – Relax & unwind in style. Pool Heat Available – Add for $50/day for extra comfort. 6-Seater Golf Cart – Explore Seagrove Beach with ease. Fully Fenced Yard – Private & secure outdoor space. Outdoor Dining for 4 – Perfect for al fresco meals. Pool Loungers & Hammock – Ultimate relaxation under the sun. Propane Grill – Fire up a family cookout.Welcome to Seagrove SandcastleWelcome to your dream getaway in the heart of Seagrove Beach, nestled along the coveted Coastal Hwy 30A. This charming 3-bedroom bungalow offers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm, just a short stroll away from the stunning shores of the Emerald Coast.Ideally situated in the popular Seagrove Beach area, you'll find yourself just minutes from the Gulf's sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The spacious, open-concept living and dining area is designed for relaxation and entertainment, featuring two plush sofas and a dining table that seats 6, ensuring plenty of space for everyone to gather.This vacation rental offers three beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with its own flat-screen TV, so everyone can enjoy their favorite shows or movies. The luxurious master suite boasts a king-sized bed and a private en suite bathroom. The kids will love the fun bunk room, which includes two twin-over-twin bunk beds. The third bedroom features a comfy king-sized bed and has access to a shared bathroom. Enjoy a relaxing and comfortable stay with all the amenities you need!The modern kitchen, outfitted with granite and stainless steel appliances, is fully equipped to make meal preparation a breeze. Whether you're whipping up a family feast or a quick snack, you'll have everything you need at your fingertips.Step outside to enjoy the newly updated (2022) saltwater pool and spa, perfect for a refreshing dip or a soothing soak. For an additional fee of $50 per day, pool heating is available to enhance your comfort. The fully fenced yard includes a 6-seater golf cart for easy trips around the neighborhood. Relax on the pool loungers, savor a meal at the outdoor dining table that seats 4, or unwind in the hammock. A propane grill is also available for those perfect cookout evenings.With its unbeatable location and excellent amenities, this bungalow provides everything needed for a memorable beach vacation. Book your stay now and experience the best of Seagrove Beach living. Don’t miss out on this coastal gem – your perfect seaside retreat awaits!Let’s Peek Inside Seagrove Sandcastle…Cozy Open Living/Dining/Entertainment AreaWhite, Modern Granite & Stainless Kitchen Fully Equipped For Meal PrepFlatscreen TV’s All BedroomsDining Table Seats 6Living Area Features 2 SofasHouse Rules**No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**AREA ATTRACTIONSWinding scenic highway 30A is composed of a diverse array of charming beach communities and quaint eclectic neighborhoods each with its own style and appeal. Seagrove Beach is noted for its central location, excellent local dining options and natural beauty. Garnished with graceful live oaks, stately magnolias and the glimmering reflection off Eastern Lake, recreational opportunities abound here including lake swimming and kayaking. Kayak rentals available lakeside!PET POLICY:-$150 non refundable Pet Fee and $500 Refundable Pet Deposit Required. 2 pets maximum. Please contact our office after booking to add your pets to your reservation. -Guests will be required to be present at the property for any maintenance issues if you are unable to crate or contain your pet.-Walton County does not allow pets on the beach without a permit. In order to obtain a permit, you must be a Walton County resident.Pool Heat*Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay*Pool heat is not guaranteed SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master Suite: (1) King BedGuest Bedroom: (1) King BedBunk Bedroom: (2) Twin-over-twin Bunk BedsShow less
